floor_history.headline: Floor 3 confirmed on the current chassis (219/219 insns); the entire residual is one $v0/$v1 seat swap, attributed by measurement to local-alloc qty_compare_1 priority, with three C forms killed again

frontier.hypothesis: Some source-level shape can put a live pseudo holding the value 2 into the instruction stream ahead of `lw $v0, 0($s0)` without changing the emitted instruction count, inverting the local-alloc priority sort and closing the last 3.
frontier.mechanism: qty_compare_1 (tools/gcc-2.7.2/local-alloc.c:1660): making the constant born strictly earlier makes the pointer the short-lived quantity (pri 10000 vs 5000), so it sorts first and takes $v0; sched2 then re-hoists the load to cover its delay slot. The naive spelling is already killed because cse/combine folds a literal holder away before lreg.
frontier.next_probe: Dump .cse and .combine for the killed named-const build (rejected/named-const-two-folded-noop-score3.c) and identify exactly which pass deletes pseudo 212's holder. That names what the value must look like to survive - and whether the surviving spelling is ordinary C or lands in a FAKE family, in which case the correct outcome is a ruling-request rather than a submission.

frontier.hypothesis: Changing what else populates the block at .L80023B90, on the SUCCESSOR side rather than the predecessor side, shifts the suid numbering enough to change the two quantities' spans.
frontier.mechanism: block composition determines the suid numbering that feeds qty_birth/qty_death into qty_compare_1. The duplicate-into-arms and hoist-above-the-if/else reshapes are predecessor-side and both measure worse; the successor side is untried.
frontier.next_probe: Move the common-tail store `*(s32 *)(arg0 + 0x74) = *(s32 *)(arg0 + 0xBC);` into this arm (it currently sits past the `j .L80023BE8` merge) and measure with `sandbox func_800238C4 --disable all`; re-run tmp/grind/func_800238C4/s1/adiff2.py to see whether the block's insn population moved the spans at all.

frontier.hypothesis: The solver suite can decide this seat assignment outright, returning REACHABLE with a ranked C-lever vector or FORECLOSED, instead of another round of hand-spelled probes.
frontier.mechanism: tools/ra_solver models GCC 2.7.2's local-alloc exactly, and inverse_compose.py classify triages residuals that are register seats; every input this residual needs is now measured (2 quantities, refs 2/2, spans 4/2, class GENERAL_REGS, block 41).
frontier.next_probe: Run `inverse_compose.py classify` on the .lreg block, then tools/ra_solver's local-alloc model with the measured quantity records from tmp/grind/func_800238C4/s1/qtydbg.txt:1237-1238; treat any returned lever vector as a hypothesis to spell in C and measure, not as a result.
